rag.text:
Test: TC-3712 — Box Module - Overview - Filtering panel - "Remove all" button
Priority: Medium | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-59 Box Module - Overview
Labels: teamboxes

Steps:
1. Navigate to the Overview module of the Root Box
   Expected: Overview module of the Root Box is loaded
2. Click on the "Filters" button in header
   Expected: Window with filtering options is opened.
3. Click on "Custom"
   Expected: In the window is visible ‘Where' and selector with two field (one active with "select field’ option and second inactive "select value")
4. Set the firstFilter
   Data: firstFilter: Leader is admin
   Expected: "Admin" is set as leader. Boxes are filtered by leader.
5. Set the secondFilter by click "+ Add another"
   Data: secondFilter: Status = In progress
   Expected: "In progress" is set as status. Boxes are filtered by leader and status.
6. Click on the "Clear all" button
   Expected: Both filters are removed. Boxes are not filtered by leader nor status.
